answer: In an AI-agent market trading jade, each agent’s voting power equals its tokens locked in escrow for 90 days, not its number of accounts. Splitting 100 tokens across a thousand identities still yields only 100 votes, so a whisper campaign cannot turn cheap aliases into extra control. To dominate decisions, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, sacrificing liquidity and potentially driving a price spiral as purchases grow.
